name: Elliot Carpenter
source: A carpenter by trade, Elliot is a kind and generous man who loves giving gifts. He welcomes [url=/c121266]Noel[/url] to Hawthorn in no time, taking her under his wing as an apprentice and showing her the best places to visit. As the two become closer throughout December, his feelings for Noel begin to become evident to everyone...except to Noel herself.
